title: Haapus
overview: Anna Gurav is terror personified! In Wanarwadi, in the picturesque Konkan, Anna's word is the LAW- because of his command over Astrology. But he is at loggerheads with Ajit, his only son who has developed a new breed of mangoes - the major bread-earner of this region.

songs.title: Asaa Asaawa
songs.singers: Anuradha Marathe, Vibhawari Joshi, Anjali Kulkarni, Amruta Subhash, Suvarna Mategaonkar, Pranjali Barve
